API

<ray-menu>

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
openopen reflectsbooleanShown.
placementplacement reflectsbottom-start | bottom | bottom-end | top-start | top | top-end | right-start | left-startbottom-startPreferred side and alignment.
contextcontext reflectsbooleanOpens on right click (contextmenu) over the trigger area, at the pointer.
keepOpenkeep-open reflectsbooleanChoosing an item does not close the menu.
EventDescription
ray-selectAn item was chosen; detail: { value, item }.
ray-openAfter it opened.
ray-closeAfter it closed.
SlotDescription
triggerThe button that opens it, or the area for a context menu.
(default)ray-menu-item, ray-menu-label and ray-menu-divider elements.
PartDescription
dropdownThe panel.

<ray-menu-item>

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
valuevalue reflectsstringReported in ray-select (default: the text).
disableddisabled reflectsbooleanSkipped by the keyboard, cannot be chosen.
colorcolor reflectsstringText and hover color (e.g. red for destructive actions).
SlotDescription
(default)Label.
leftIcon.
rightShortcut or badge.

<ray-menu-label>

A section caption inside the menu.
